```sql
WITH chemung_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Chemung' AND border_type = 'city'
),
elevation_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_Area(ST_Clip(r.rast, true, c.geom, true)) / ST_Area(c.geom)) * 100 AS percent_area_above_300
  FROM chemung_geom c
  CROSS JOIN public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, c.geom)
    AND ST_ValueCount(
      ST_Clip(r.rast, true, c.geom, true),
      1,
      300,
      true
    ) > 0
)
SELECT percent_area_above_300
FROM elevation_analysis;
```
